objective: Develop a canon-safe scenario pitch and protagonist motivation approval packet.
scope: Identify which story choices require Human Director approval.
Explain how each pitch supports the first playable loop.
Prepare approval items for protagonist motivation and any canon-sensitive premise.
non_goals: No canon write without Human Director approval.
No implementation task creation from staff consensus alone.

approval_items.plain_language_summary: Choose whether the protagonist motivation becomes approved project canon.
what_will_change: Approved motivation will guide later scenario, quest, and presentation work.
what_will_not_change: No JSON data or schema will change.
No assets will be generated or imported.
files_or_memory_affected: future MemoryRecord with status=canon only after approval
risks: If approved too early, later gameplay direction may conflict with story motivation.
If left undecided, scenario work remains provisional.
rollback_plan: Keep rejected motivations as rejected memory.
Supersede approved motivation only through a later Human Director decision.
evidence_required: Canon or approved decision memory reference.

evidence_requirements: Human Director approval decision for canon-sensitive items.
verification_plan: Confirm all options label canon status clearly.
Confirm no implementation, data, asset, commit, or push action is implied.
Confirm approval items explain what changes and what does not change.
